hero.title: Khoury Youssef of Sereel
hero.subtitle: Guardian Saint of Our Village
hero.description: Discover the sacred life, miracles, and eternal legacy of Saint Khoury Youssef

home.miracleDescription: A faithful pilgrim experienced complete recovery from a severe illness after praying at the shrine of Khoury Youssef.
home.visitDescription: The shrine of Khoury Youssef in Sereel has been a sanctuary of faith for generations.
home.aboutDescription1: Saint Khoury Youssef of Sereel stands as a beacon of faith and devotion.
home.aboutDescription2: Through centuries, his intercession has brought healing, hope, and miracles to countless faithful.
